entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. This takes about three minutes, and your code shows on this screen as soon as we finish. Who's the globe for?

It's for my son, he turns twelve next month and he is really into maps and geography at school. To be honest I have been going back and forth on this for a couple of weeks now, reading reviews at night after the kids are in bed, comparing sizes and prices, and trying to picture where it would actually sit in his room so it does not get knocked over, because he is twelve and his desk is always covered in books, pencils and little projects.
